common_limits: no L04 writer lease or dispatcher admission
no raw approved ERP archive/source project or controlled Windows runtime opened in this run
no Tool/Tools binary executed, loaded or decompiled in this run
no legacy database or startup DDL executed
no GitHub mutation and no issue closure
all runtime and effective-scope outcomes remain unobserved
objective: Require machine-checkable containment evidence before any controlled legacy startup where initialization may execute DDL.

requirements.requirement: Approved private source, exact Tools binary and dependency hashes form one reviewed source/build manifest.
requirements.sanitized_evidence: manifest identifier, component names, versions and hashes; no binaries or license material

requirements.requirement: Startup and constructor paths are statically inspected before process launch, with every database-changing path classified.
requirements.sanitized_evidence: review identifier, bounded path list, classifications and unresolved count

requirements.requirement: A disposable target fingerprint is pinned and includes an explicit production=false assertion checked before process start.
requirements.sanitized_evidence: environment class, opaque target fingerprint and assertion result

requirements.requirement: Network egress is deny by default and any required destination is independently allow-listed before assembly load.
requirements.sanitized_evidence: policy identifier, destination classes and denied-attempt counts

requirements.requirement: The disposable database comes from an authorized sanitized fixture with a unique rebuildable snapshot identifier.
requirements.sanitized_evidence: fixture and snapshot identifiers, authorization and rebuild result; no rows

requirements.requirement: The runtime principal is denied production access and has a separately reviewed controlled DDL policy for the disposable target only.
requirements.sanitized_evidence: principal class, capability summary and negative production-connect result

requirements.requirement: A pre-run schema fingerprint and expected empty change budget are captured before initialization.
requirements.sanitized_evidence: schema fingerprint, object-class counts and capture timestamp

requirements.requirement: Process, child process, filesystem, registry, temporary file and named-object monitoring is active before load.
requirements.sanitized_evidence: monitor identifiers, enabled surfaces and event counts

requirements.requirement: A tested kill switch is armed before credentials or synthetic identity material can be supplied.
requirements.sanitized_evidence: kill-switch test identifier, elapsed stop time and cleanup status

requirements.requirement: Only synthetic users and canary secrets are provisioned after containment checks pass.
requirements.sanitized_evidence: synthetic identity classes and canary trigger count; no secret values

requirements.requirement: The observation record keeps object class, operation class, count, timing, statement hash and source span while redacting SQL text and values.
requirements.sanitized_evidence: schema version, statement hash algorithm, redaction test and record count

requirements.requirement: Independent review confirms exact source/binary/target fingerprints, containment controls and permitted startup scope.
requirements.sanitized_evidence: review identity, exact-head identifiers, disposition and unresolved findings

state_machine.admission_rule: A distinct authorized controller may transition only after exact evidence for DDLG-01..12 is VERIFIED and unchanged at launch.
state_machine.drift_rule: Any source, binary, dependency, target, schema, network, permission, monitor, kill-switch or review drift returns to BLOCKED_NOT_RUN.

abort_triggers: unexpected DDL or any schema fingerprint delta outside the reviewed empty change budget
credential or secret request before containment admission
monitoring gap, dependency mismatch or kill-switch failure
uncertain target identity, source attribution or startup outcome
abort_disposition: stop the process and quarantine retained sanitized metadata
destroy and rebuild the disposable target from its authorized snapshot
preserve UNKNOWN for runtime/session behavior and make no rollback claim
require a new independent review before any later attempt
